## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; mixed internals with strong 1W winners but notable big-name divergences; Leadership: Moderate (3/5 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +20.34% | 1M: +0.13%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +15.10% | 1M: -3.67%) RECOVERY. Consumer Discretionary strong: F (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +25.31%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +11.18% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing momentum: QCOM (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy weak: COP (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -6.65% | 1M: +1.29%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples soft: WMT (1W: -11.08% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND, COST (1W: -6.83% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure with divergence: TTWO (1W: -8.87% | 1M: +4.71%) CORRECTION, META (1W: +0.18% | 1M: -9.29%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5 by 1W: QCOM (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) ABOVE TREND; VST (1W: +20.34% | 1M: +0.13%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%) ABOVE TREND; F (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +25.31%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +16.09% | 1M: +20.50%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate (3/5 sectors represented).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: DE (1W: -6.27% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND; COP (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND; UBER (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -6.06%) BELOW TREND; XOM (1W: -6.65% | 1M: +1.29%) CORRECTION; COST (1W: -6.83% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy/Industrials/Staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Largest 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +20.34% | 1M: +0.13%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%) ABOVE TREND; downside momentum: INTU (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%) BELOW TREND. Major divergence present: NVDA (1W: -3.36% | 1M: +3.16%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -1.85% | 1M: +5.73%) CORRECTION — suppress strong directional calls.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed but constructive on breadth; AAPL (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.36% | 1M: +3.16%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.81%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%) BELOW TREND. Technology (1W: +3.61% | 1M: +12.56%) remains a source of leadership but internals are uneven.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are steady but mixed: JPM (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.85% | 1M: +5.73%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -2.21%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND. Financials (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +0.86%) contributing to breadth but not uniformly strong.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare shows pockets of strength: LLY (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +20.66%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +1.76%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -3.65% | 1M: +6.18%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -2.68%) RECOVERY. Healthcare (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +1.60%) is positive and supported by bullish news flow in parts of the sector.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective exposure to clear 1W leaders (QCOM, AMD, LLY) while reducing exposure to structurally weak names (INTU, WMT, COST). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given major divergences between large-cap tech and broader cyclical strength.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +20.66%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%) BELOW TREND; WMT (1W: -11.08% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND; DE (1W: -6.27% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +4.77%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: +4.69%) for follow-through; Technology (1W: +3.61%) for selective momentum. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -4.03%), Consumer Staples (1W: -1.29%) and Communication for continued dispersion; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA (1W: -3.36% | 1M: +3.16%) CORRECTION — reclaiming recent weekly highs would signal trend resumption. AAPL (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold the 1M uptrend would warn of broader tech softening. QCOM (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) ABOVE TREND — a weekly close below the recent gap would flag momentum loss. INTU (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%) BELOW TREND — monitor for continuation below monthly lows.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
NVDA (+60): NVDA (1W: -3.36% | 1M: +3.16%) CORRECTION — strong bullish headlines but weekly price soft → divergence, watch for distribution vs accumulation. ROST (+60): ROST (1W: +11.18% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND — news and price confirming accumulation. QCOM (+50): QCOM (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTU (-50): INTU (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirmed by sharp price decline. UBER (-50): UBER (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -6.06%) BELOW TREND — negative news and price aligned. PFE (-55): PFE (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -2.68%) RECOVERY — bearish news but weekly price strength = divergence, monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. QCOM (1W: +22.19% | 1M: +67.16%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +19.69% | 1M: +44.88%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while INTU (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -23.13%) BELOW TREND and WMT (1W: -11.08% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND are showing weakness. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (NVDA, GOOGL, V) and mixed news confirmations (NVDA bullish headlines vs weekly weakness) — watch for trend breaks.
